description: 100% safe queue operations with overflow/underflow prevention. All operations are formally verified to maintain queue invariants.

atoms.name: enqueue
atoms.description: Add an element to the bounded queue, returning the new length. Prevents overflow by requiring len < cap.

atoms.name: dequeue
atoms.description: Remove an element from the bounded queue, returning the new length. Prevents underflow by requiring len > 0.

atoms.name: is_empty
atoms.description: Check whether the queue is empty (returns 1 if empty, 0 otherwise).

atoms.name: is_full
atoms.description: Check whether the queue is at capacity (returns 1 if full, 0 otherwise).
atoms.ensures: result >= 0 && result <= 1 && (len == cap => result == 1) && (len < cap => result == 0)
